title: Record actual effort when a step closes
goal: A closed step records `actualDays` with its source: measured from work-usage elapsed for jobs linked to the task, or an owner/agent statement labelled as such
acceptance: `effort.actualDays` and `effort.actualSource` (`work-usage`, `stated`); a stated value is never shown as measured
`work-items close <task>` proposes the work-usage figure when the ledger has closed jobs for that task and reports when coverage is partial (open jobs, missing intervals)
Wall-clock includes waits (CI, owner); the record says so instead of subtracting guesses
privacy: Metadata only: estimates, dates, durations and task identities; no prompts, transcripts or personal data.
validation: Fixtures: task with complete work-usage jobs, with partial coverage, with none (stated only)

effort.basis: work-usage already reports per-task elapsed unions; this links them to the task record. Implemented 2026-11-11 in one branch with F-053–F-055; review and release remain. Estimate, not a measurement.

escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner (BACKLOG-RULES, "Optional upfront feature plans")
